name: Projected Double Density or Projected Average Degree of Half-intervals
proof: Every coordinate projection of the initial-segment class is a chain, so its $1$-inclusion graph is a path.  It has at most $n$ distinct vertices, whose average degree is at most $2(n-1)/n$.  The full projection is already a path on $n$ intervals (and so is a projection omitting the first coordinate), attaining this value.
